query: INSERT INTO skipped_fills (chain, tx_hash, log_index, event_type, reason, detail, skipped_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (chain, tx_hash, log_index) DO UPDATE SET event_type = excluded.event_type, reason = excluded.reason, detail = excluded.detail || ' (earlier skipped as ' || skipped_fills.reason || ' on ' || skipped_fills.event_type || ' at ' || skipped_fills.skipped_at || ': ' || skipped_fills.detail || ')', skipped_at = excluded.skipped_at WHERE skipped_fills.reason <> excluded.reason
